title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Given a string s containing just the characters "(", ")", "{", "}", "[" and "]", determine if the input string is valid.

examples.explanation: Every opening bracket is immediately closed by its matching type in the correct order.
The closing square bracket ']' does not match the open parenthesis '('.
The brackets are correctly nested: the inner bracket pair '[]' is closed before the outer '{' is closed.

hints: Push opening brackets onto a LIFO stack.
When encountering a closing bracket, check if top of stack matches.
The stack must be completely empty at the end.
